EmailTemplate.subject: 3000 patients speak on what drives them to pay
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Pymnts.com, the most influential media outlet in the world around payments and commerce, surveyed nearly 3 thousand patients to gain insight into the key factors that drive patients to pay and meet their responsibility to your health system.
The paper, The Changing Landscape of Healthcare Payment Plans, <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/changing-landscape-healthcare-payment-plans?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> outlines how health systems are finding that a patient financial experience centered around affordability increases revenue cycle outcomes and is linked to much higher levels of patient satisfaction.
In addition to Pymnts.com’s key findings, they outline a number of recommendations – download a free copy of the paper to learn more. <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/changing-landscape-healthcare-payment-plans?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
